human_approval.conversation_reference: Exact quote or stable reference to one current human approval; this file is not approval.

metadata.title: Exact pull request title approved at intake

constraints: Only the exact repository, worktree, Git remote, base SHA, topic branch, paths, PR identity binding, title, label/milestone/reviewer values, merge method, and stages listed here are in scope
The final head is the tip produced by this run from only the allowed paths; any unexpected commit invalidates the remaining stages
No force-push, direct default-branch push, secret, credential, permission, repository-setting, release, tag, workflow-dispatch, live, production, destructive-data, or Homelab change
Every remote stage uses the normal Codex approval system and repository rules; this envelope never bypasses a platform permission prompt
abort_conditions: The envelope expires or no longer matches the current conversation approval
Repository, worktree, base branch, base SHA, topic branch, path scope, or PR identity differs from the approved values
The diff contains an out-of-scope path or the branch contains an unexpected commit
A required or reported check fails, a review requests changes, a review thread remains unresolved, or mergeability is not clean
A readback is ambiguous, contradictory, unavailable, or reveals a side effect outside this envelope
validation_steps: Before push, stage only explicit allowed_paths, compare the staged and committed diff with that allowlist, and read back the local head SHA plus the unchanged remote base SHA
Push only the exact topic branch to the exact named remote; after each push, read back its remote SHA and require it to equal the current run-produced local tip

Create the first pull request as Draft with explicit --repo, --base, --head, exact --title, and one explicit body input; labels, milestone, and reviewers may only use the exact values in this envelope
Before ready-for-review, read back PR identity, base, head SHA, complete diff, checks, reviews, and unresolved threads
Immediately before merge, repeat the PR, base SHA, head SHA, diff, checks, reviews, threads, mergeability, and merge-method readback; invoke exact --repo and method with --match-head-commit
After merge, read back the resulting default-branch SHA and required checks before any approved cleanup
After cleanup, prove only the exact merged topic branch was removed and retain a durable completion record
